Part-time and contract employees have similar access to health and retirement benefits as 
full-time employees. Benefits related to life insurance, vacation, and tuition reimbursement  
are prorated for part-time employees. Contract employees are not eligible for a number of 
benefits, including long-term disability, equity incentive plan, and tuition reimbursement.  
Part-time and contract employees are not eligible for our sabbatical benefit.
